recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞大小與形態差異極大：有核呈花瓣狀、多葉或多核的巨大漿細胞，也有雙核與核偏位、帶細胞質空泡的漿細胞，低倍下漿細胞明顯增多，呈現骨髓瘤的「多種形態」。
features: Increased plasma cells with marked pleomorphism in cell size and nuclear configuration
Giant multinucleated/multilobated plasma cells with flower-like (cloverleaf) nuclear arrangement and abundant blue cytoplasm (C)
Binucleate and nuclei with deep clefts or segmentation (A, B), some with a distinct perinuclear hof
Chromatin ranges from coarse clockface to finely dispersed; occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles and pale inclusions
Low power (D): numerous plasma cells of variable size among residual hematopoietic cells; smear background yellowish
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a marked increase in plasma cells with striking pleomorphism. Many are large, with bi- or multinucleation and flower-like multilobated nuclei set in abundant basophilic cytoplasm, while others are binucleate or mononuclear with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and small cytoplasmic vacuoles. At lower power the plasma cells are numerous and variable in size among residual hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with pleomorphic (multinucleated/multilobated) plasma cell morphology; clonality should be confirmed by light chain restriction and cytogenetic/FISH risk assessment performed.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, mostly perivascular and polytypic, without giant multinucleated or multilobated forms.
Megakaryocytes have granular pink cytoplasm with a single lobulated nucleus and osteoclasts have many separate uniform nuclei, whereas these cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with hofs.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are immunoblastic with prominent central nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBV+ and extramedullary, rather than mature-appearing pleomorphic plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters (cytokeratin+) and ALCL hallmark cells are CD30+ T cells, while myeloma cells are CD138+ with monotypic cytoplasmic light chain.

captions: Plasma cells with multilobated and eccentric nuclei
Binucleate and cleaved plasma cells with basophilic cytoplasm
Low power: numerous pleomorphic plasma cells
